response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT brokrepstat AS status, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS value FROM status_averages), qualifying AS (SELECT s.status, s.avg_modelconf, s.avg_modelconf - b.value AS above_baseline FROM status_averages s CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE s.avg_modelconf > b.value), qualifying_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS value FROM qualifying) SELECT q.status, q.avg_modelconf, q.above_baseline, q.avg_modelconf / m.value AS relative_to_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying q CROSS JOIN baseline b CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean m WHERE b.value IS NOT NULL AND m.value IS NOT NULL;
